note: Default routines seeded into every project's Work › Routines (LAY-04C). A routine creates an ordinary work item when due, never a second one while its last is still open. Cadence: weekly, monthly, or before-release (each preview build).

routines.title: Product drift check
documents: Product › stories whose built behaviour and acceptance disagree

routines.title: Accessibility sweep
documents: Pages › pages with contrast, focus or labelling problems

routines.title: Dependency updates
documents: Platform › dependency versions and what changed

routines.title: Security audit before release
documents: Platform › security findings for this release
